name: Mimetas OrganoPlate 3-lane 64 6405-400-B 384 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes:
Dimensions are in meters. Registered on the plate's 384-well microtitre lattice, which is what the rows/columns/pitch schema expresses and what a full-coverage acquisition mode needs to reach every chip; the chip lattice is described below but is not what this file's grid encodes.

CONTROLLING DOCUMENT. MIMETAS drawing '3-lane 64 (6405-400-B)', Edition E, dated 29/04/2025, scale 1:1, unit mm, designed by F. Schavemaker, checked and approved by B. Trietsch, marked '- Confidential -', sheet 1/1. Supplied as '20250429_3-lane 64 (6405-400-B) Technical Drawing Rev_E.pdf'. The sheet uses a comma decimal separator except in the glass note block. This drawing is confidential and is not published by MIMETAS; it is on file at Ramona Optics (Slack DM, 2026-09-15, forwarded by Jarrett Bliton for the GSK demo) rather than online. web_reference therefore points at the MIMETAS product page, which is the highest-authority PUBLIC document; the product specification flyer for 6405-400-B was also read and is cited below.

FROM THE DRAWING, as dimensioned callouts: outer_plate_dimensions.length 127.80 +/- 0.2 mm; width 85.50 +/- 0.2 mm; height 14.4 +/- 0.1 mm (overall plate height, Section A-A; no lid is shown or dimensioned on the drawing). alignment_reference.offset_from_left_edge 12.1 +/- 0.05 mm and offset_from_top_edge 9 +/- 0.05 mm, both taken off the outer plate edges in the Top View; the drawing carries no datum symbols and never labels a well 'A1', so A1 is taken to be the corner well nearest those two edges. well_dimensions.pitch 4.50 mm. The drawing prints 127.80 x 85.50, not the ANSI/SLAS 4-2004 nominal 127.76 x 85.48; the drawing's numbers are used here. Note the plate is NOT a 127.76 footprint with a 12.13/8.99 A1 -- the vendor's own values are close to but not the standard's.

SCALED OFF THE DRAWING, not dimensioned: well_dimensions.diameter 0.0036 m is the top opening of the rounded-square microtitre well, flat-to-flat. MIMETAS does not dimension the well opening on any of the three OrganoPlate drawings. It was measured off the 1:1 vector geometry three times and independently: 3.61 mm on 4004-400-B Rev F (1200 dpi raster, calibrated on the 4.50 mm pitch), 3.65 mm on 6405-400-B Rev E and 3.68 mm on 6401-400-B Rev D (PDF path coordinates, calibrated on the 127.80 mm footprint; those two are stroke-centreline, inside-of-stroke gives 3.55 and 3.58). All three close on the pitch against the measured rib between openings (3.61 + 0.89 = 4.50). 0.0036 m is the rounded consensus. The rounded-square corner radius is about 0.5 mm, also scaled and not dimensioned. The schema has no square field, so the flat-to-flat width is recorded in 'diameter' and 'shape' is 'square'; the Ø2.00 mm figure that appears on the drawings is the chip access aperture in the floor of the well, NOT the well opening, and must not be used as the diameter.

DERIVED: well_dimensions.depth 0.01159 m = 14.4 mm overall plate height minus 2.81 mm, the drawing's 'Distance to top of top glass', both measured from the bottom face of the plate skirt. The drawing does not dimension well depth. The derivation is corroborated by scaling the well wall height off Section A-A (1:1) at about 11.64 mm. bottom_shape 'flat' is from the depiction in Section A-A -- tapered (draft) walls standing on a flat laminate floor -- and is not stated as a note.

BOTTOM THICKNESS AND WORKING DISTANCE. This is the number that decides whether the objective can focus. The drawing's note block, all measured from the bottom face of the plate skirt: 'Glass substrate thickness: .15' (150 um, 1H coverslip thickness per the flyer); 'Microfluidics height: .22'; 'Distance to bottom glass 2.29'; 'Distance to focal plane: 2.44'; 'Distance to top of top glass: 2.81'. The stack closes: 2.29 + 0.15 = 2.44, so the focal plane is the top surface of the 150 um bottom glass, i.e. 2.44 mm above the plate underside. Materials per the flyer: top plate virgin polystyrene, bottom plate optical quality 150 um glass, microfluidics glass and proprietary polymers. The drawing itself says only 'Glass substrate' with no grade.

CHIP LAYOUT. 64 tissue culture chips, 8 chip-rows x 8 chip-columns, counted off the Bottom View. Each chip spans a 2 well-row x 3 well-column block, so the chip cell is 13.50 x 9.00 mm and the 64 chips tile the 16 x 24 lattice exactly -- every one of the 384 positions sits over a chip, with no orphan positions. The drawing shows 5 Ø2.00 mm wells per chip (3 in the upper well-row, 2 at the left and right of the lower well-row); the lower-middle position carries no aperture and is where the lanes converge and where Section C-C is cut -- that is the viewing position. All 384 openings are moulded identically; only what is drawn inside them differs.

NOT AVAILABLE FROM ANY DOCUMENT READ: footprint corner radius, skirt/flange height, lid height, plate colour, surface treatment, sterility statement, and well volumes (the flyer gives medium volume 50 uL recommended per well, 15-90 uL possible, and ECM-gel loading volume 2.0 uL, which are working volumes rather than geometric ones).

OTHER DOCUMENTS READ: MIMETAS product specification flyer 'OrganoPlate 3-lane 64, Product code 6405-400-B' (2023). It states: SBS Standard 384 well plate; 64 chips; a chip connects to 6 wells in a 2 x 3 well grid with the central well providing viewing access; chip lattice 9.0 mm x 4.5 mm; the 2.2 mm chip dimension; perfusion channels 425 um, ECM channel 300 um, total 1350 um, channel height 220 um, PhaseGuide 55 um; bottom plate optical quality 150 um glass (1H coverslip thickness).

SIBLING PART NUMBERS in the same OrganoPlate family, not registered here: 4004-400-B (3-lane 40), 6405-400-B (3-lane 64), 6401-400-B (Graft), 9603-400-B (2-lane 96). All share the 127.80 x 85.50 x 14.4 mm 384-well top and differ in the microfluidic layer.

DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN VENDOR DOCUMENTS: the flyer calls the chip a '2 x 3 well grid' with a 'central well' -- a 2 x 3 block has no central well. The drawing resolves it: the viewing position is the middle of the lower well-row, which is the one position of the six with no Ø2.00 aperture. The flyer's 'SBS Standard 384 well plate' also sits against the drawing's 127.80 x 85.50 rather than the standard's 127.76 x 85.48. The drawing wins in this file.

NO PUBLIC DOCUMENT STATES THIS PLATE'S DIMENSIONS. Every footprint, height and A1 number in this file comes from the confidential Rev E drawing on file at Ramona. web_reference is therefore the live MIMETAS product page, which is the highest-authority public document for the part; it carries no dimensions. The 2023 product specification flyer was read from the distributor mirror https://www.ycytek.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/10/2022_Flyer_OrganoPlate-3-lane-64_product-specifications.pdf and from the Wayback capture https://web.archive.org/web/20240702200927id_/https://www.mimetas.com/files/products/OrganoPlate%203-lane%2064/2023_Productflyer_3_lane_64_Specification%20sheet.pdf ; it states only 'SBS Standard 384 well plate' with no mm. The footprint, height and A1 offsets on Rev E are identical to those on the Graft Rev D and 3-lane 40 Rev F drawings, and identical to the publicly archived dimensioned drawing on page 4 of MIMETAS' 'OrganoPlate Graft Automated Tissue Placement' protocol V1.0, which is consistent with a shared 384-well top plate across the family. The MIMETAS 3-lane 64 tubule seeding protocol V1.0 confirms the chip tiling in words: chips occupy columns 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 20, 23 and rows A, C, E, G, I, K, M, O, i.e. a 3-column x 2-row repeat over the 24 x 16 grid, and names the six chip wells (1 left perfusion inlet, 2 left perfusion outlet, 3 gel inlet, 4 observation window, 5 right perfusion inlet, 6 right perfusion outlet). US patent 10,532,355 B2 (MIMETAS B.V.) independently states the 4.5 mm 384-well pitch.
